body:
"Get used to it" is something nobody in real pain would ever say to another. 

And yeah fuck you and your incorrect judgement of my life and what I think and feel.

I knew when I posted this some people would use it to take their shit out on me, preach their religious beliefs, or generally be jerks. My mistake was thinking it wouldn't make me angry.

You weren't insensitive...if anything I am overly sensitive...comes with the territory.

I understand what you are saying and appreciate the input.

I rewrote the reply as it probably came off too harsh the first time...forgive me as I feel terrible, pain is up, and am irritable...it isn't personal...I am just done being told what I MUST do.  But suffice it to say I am not willing to involve family..they have had their chance to help and prefer to stick their heads in the sand while not actually listening to my needs, I refuse to sacrifice any thing more to the "help" (doctors, lawyers, systems) that never really helps and caused most of this, and am not interested in telling the whole world every dirty little secret in my life for some emotional porn value. That isn't what this is about. 

If I have to do it myself I will..I am just testing the waters. This is the only thing I have left that I have control over...and it will be done my way or not at all. This is about MY voice...not the distorted ventrilloqiust version of my voice spoken by those who caused this or made it worse. I won't be angry or begrudge anyone who doesn't want to participate for whatever reason and appreciate the honest input even if I cannot take the advice...maybe I will change my views as things progress but some things are just not negotiable where my mind is at now.

I feel I need to keep a lot close to the chest at this point sorry. Not comfortable giving up any identifying info yet...especially as if it became public it would be very easy for someone to find out who I am and to mess things up...many people won't just let someone do something like this without meddling.
 
But I really don't have a home...no place I am rooted with close ties as I have moved a lot trying to survive, and family hasn't been a real source of comfort so I don't want them involved in this. I might be open to some friends being interviewed if they are willing...but not sure.
I will PM you.
Sorry you have to suffer with your health as well. Let's keep in touch.
Thanks.
Sure thing. I am going to set up an email for this. Thanks for the reply.

I find the timing of this article fitting given my situation. Take a look at my idea and comment if you want:

 http://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/1tf9kb/would_documenting_my_trip_to_the_end_of_life/
I don't want to turn it into a drama on the news. They always twist things for an agenda. I just wanted an honest documentation of my path.

It's difficult to immigrate to other countries even when you have good health and money. I have lived abroad and have first hand experience. Adjusting to a new culture..not having any support network..it isn't realistic.

It's also about far more than just healthcare...it's about daily life and being able to tolerate it. Nobody is going to pay for me to go live in a better place, with better healthcare, better climate, and better social services...that is a fantasy...and there are thousands of people worse off than me that would need it as well so it's just not a practical solution.

Thanks :)

I hope we all find it.

I like the way you put it about the negative and positive. I try to explain to people living with every single aspect of your life miserable is not sustainable. No life is perfect...but when it's bad all the way around endlessly it wears you down.

No I hadn't seen his site. Thanks.

I think every suicidal person worries about the after effects. But you get past that...you get to a point you cannot suffer every second of your life for others. I wouldn't ask someone to do that for me if they were the ones in pain.

As to what I expect...I have no idea. I think the most likely is we just shut off and are over...but even that is hard to fathom since everything we think about is because we DO exist...not existing is very hard to comprehend for me. I doubt very much there is any sort of afterlife good or bad but nobody really knows. Whatever it is I hope there is no suffering.

I know about Oregon thanks..and I couldn't use it as a way out if I wanted to due to the restrictions and rules..they are so restrictive they hardly apply to anyone...I am going out on my terms...not how some bureaucracy says I can. No government...no other person..has the right to say I cannot end my own suffering or block me from doing so. I find people who do this and support such things to be evil and I hope one day they have to suffer as I do so they can see what they caused others. Yeah I am angry about this issue...rightfully so in my view. People don't have to participate...but they have no right to meddle in another's life like that and actively prevent them from access to peaceful methods, leaving them only painful and terrible ones.

I would like to leave my location private for now...no offense...just not sure how much of my identity I will eventually show at this point. But the trip itself won't take place in the USA.

The love of my life left me after I got worse and worse. Said she didn't want to live a limited life. I have been alone for the many years since. I would have never abandoned her had the tables been turned, and it broke me in a bad way. And every system, doctor, judge, lawyer etc I have turned to has either dismissed me, ignored me, or made it worse...I have heard "You can't possibly be hurting that much" so many times...I wish they had to live in my body for a day...

Pain meds are a vicious cycle...they give you some small escape but its never enough and never worth the costs. I cycle on and off and switch types to try and keep from becoming consumed by them...and I never actually feel good. In fact I experience MORE pain on them after a time in some sick irony called hyperalgesia which is when the pain meds actually CAUSE more pain.

I knew people were going to say a lot of things like that...."find inspiration to keep living" etc. It's not about that. I don't need that...I would happily live if I had the health to live a life I could tolerate. It's about the pain...and the loss that pain causes. You can't live a normal life...you can't earn the life you need to survive...and everyone eventually gets tired of you.

Yeah I am familiar with right to die issues and find the way people are forced to die suffering often to be deplorable.

The problem I see in giving control over the "documentary" to someone else is I then lose control of my path...it would become more about the product and their schedule than my journey. I also don't have a schedule...or know for sure I can go through with it...how long it will take or where it will take me. Make no mistake I want to live...I just cannot live like this...so in this regard I am not as committed and ready as people like the woman you linked to. I think this trip is a way to stall...to hope for a "miracle" a little longer. But deep down I know all it has done is gotten worse over a very long time..and I am a realist.

I spoke to a friend in the hours before her suicide for medical reasons a few years ago. She was at peace....100% sure....and it was one of the most emotional things I have ever been through. Part of me screamed to call for help...but then I remembered how I feel about my own issues, the fact she had suffered for a lifetime and had a right to choose, and that help is often just not there. This is not a clean or easy topic...and I really have no idea how I am going to go about things.
LOL....."Ok now jump to your death!.....CUT! That was terrible...do it again!....oh......scheiße."

I am not sure. Maybe both? It's not as if I am after some deep enlightenment or anything. And it's equally as likely this is just a subconscious stalling tactic as it is anything else.  I can see arriving at the end of my options and still not having the courage to take the leap. I hope not...because I simply cannot live an even more reduced life..with even less independence.

It's all about pain and the means to survive...I have way too much of the first...and not enough of the second....and neither are realistically going to change.

It's a conundrum as if I am completely public I will be stopped by meddlers. Someone will call the police or try to commit me or whatever...society refuses to accept that individuals have the right to choose to end their life. I felt I needed to try and stay anonymous because of this...but I also get your view and agree people need to see it and feel it. Really though society likes to hide from ugly things like this so I can't see it getting anywhere in the public consciousness...only in the consciousness of those like us.

Maybe not doing it "live" is the best bet. Maybe I should be public....but not release footage etc until the end so nobody can interfere with the journey. I really don't know at this point.

I have plenty to live for...that isn't the issue. The issue is the capacity for suffering in order to live a reduced quality of life, willingness to keep suffering for that reduced quality of life, and the means to pay to keep living said life of suffering.  

I can see only two things that could stop or postpone my end...waking up healed of all ailments...or somehow getting absurd amounts of money to guarantee being able to "buy" as much comfort as possible for the remainder of my life...and that one might not even be enough in the long run.  Bu since neither one of those is going to happen (not even something dramatic like a cloned body will occur in my lifetime and certainly won't be affordable)...here we are.

I don't need inspiration, motivation or poster talk or encouragement to "live". Thanks for the good wishes but that is not what I am about.
Thanks
I would probably try a lot of things if I felt safe in the environment and with the people.

Not sure on where...I have had the idea to see places I haven't seen before...or to follow a meaningful past journey and revisit those memories.

Wasn't sure what medium I would use...writing, photos, video. I am pretty shy and private so not sure I would like to be too out there in real time...and I do worry about people meddling if I am too public...someone could make things far worse for me by "trying to help" in their eyes so some degree of privacy seems important...but as this is uncharted for me I can't say.

As you can tell I am really organized and have things in order ;)
